notes.text: The heading is underlined Proposition. The sheet is handwritten on otherwise blank paper. No date or separate authorial page number is visible. A light-pencil 39 occurs at the bottom left and is retained only as the archive-sheet-number comment.

The author writes the two displayed sets C_{geq x}={y in C | y geq x} and C_{leq x}={y in C | y leq x}, followed by the assertion that they are “tot” with a raised t/l, “ordonnés.” The four non-strict order signs in these definitions have visible lower strokes. This records the source statement without adding a theorem or hypotheses.

The proof setup contains the author’s phrase “(par dualité)”, two raised additions le and pour, and cancelled starters. The subsequent display writes x<y, x<z, y unequal z, followed by “alors (y,z) comparables.” The visible letters, including cel/cela and aussi/ceci, are retained independently of the expected prose.

The bracketed note reads “non congrus mod” sigma and “à cause de 28 a)”. The first reference has no opening parenthesis. The later reference is written “(28) a).” No referenced page was consulted; the reference is recorded as the author wrote it.

The continuation discusses the source’s y,z incomparability and sigma y,z comparability, then uses the phrase “ce qui contredit x<y par (28) a).” This is the author’s argument as written. The heavily retraced comparisons after z and x remain < versus less-than-or-equal uncertain; the argument is not used to decide their extra horizontal strokes.

The lower revision replaces a cancelled ne peut avoir with the raised “aurait donc.” The final line contains sigma y<z, “d’où”, sigma z<, and a single falling diagonal. The diagonal does not complete a readable operand; none has been added. No explicit authorial question or check mark is present on this page.

The diagram is reproduced as an arrow diagram, preserving its three actual solid dots, the z label beside an arrowhead, four rising heads, and the interrupted shaft pieces. The drawing is kept aligned to the left of the bracketed prose.

workflow_feedback.sequence: Read brief, supplied notation and page packet/witnesses; viewed the whole once for layout and each half once line by line; created and actually viewed 17 local enhanced crops once each; saved the complete reading.tex before composing return.json.
workflow_feedback.image_processing: Pillow crop from the original 1690 by 2358 image, autocontrast, LANCZOS enlargement to 3000 pixels wide, sharpness factor 1.65. No rotation was needed for these horizontal targets.
workflow_feedback.source_bounds: Original dimensions were checked before cropping. Findings give complete original target boxes, including descenders and punctuation space; stacked revision component boxes are included.
workflow_feedback.limitation: Crop 02 was too short at the bottom to contain the lowest q continuation. This is explicitly recorded in F02; the full target is visible in the once-viewed half a, the uncertainty is retained, and no second crop of the locus was made. Other intended target extents, including both layers of the lower revision, lie inside their crops.
workflow_feedback.scope: Only the assigned scan040 packet, C/H witnesses, preambles, permitted briefs and notation table were read. No OCR, outside research, compilation, other page image or other reader output was used. No proof check was performed.
workflow_feedback.quote_check: Every finding’s C and H quotation was checked as an exact substring of its supplied page witness. H editorial notation and rewriting notes were considered before the collation flags were set.
